description: This file defines the MidiEventThread class, which extends MidiEventScheduler. It manages a thread (EventThread) that handles MIDI events asynchronously, sending them via a MidiDispatcher. It includes start and stop controls for the thread and interacts with MIDI events and senders.

classes.name: MidiEventThread
classes.description: Main class managing MIDI event scheduling via an internal thread.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread, responsible for processing MIDI events asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the internal EventThread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests the internal EventThread to stop and waits for it to terminate.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender associated with this MIDI dispatcher.
